# A numerical substitution with about three consecutive numbers per letter. The strict count is 29: the contributor's 28, plus 60 = Y, counted from 6 Nov 2026 (see VERIFICATION.md section 6).
# Values marked telegram7677 and letter-word are our additions on 6 Nov 2026 (see VERIFICATION.md), not part of the contributor's count.
